title: Elden Ring Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 Location
description: Find Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 in Elden Ring, follow the route from Beside the Great Bridge, and unlock unlimited Somber Smithing Stone 9 purchases.
body:
**Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is in Crumbling Farum Azula, one floor below the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.** From the grace, turn around, ride the elevator down, descend the stairs and enter the chapel. The Bell Bearing is on a corpse beside the altar.

Give it to the **Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold** to unlock an unlimited supply of **Somber Smithing Stone [9]**. Each stone costs 25,000 runes.

This is a late-game pickup, not a boss reward. You can return for it later if you pass the chapel without collecting it.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Elden Ring item pickup screen showing Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 obtained beside an altar in Crumbling Farum Azula.
imageCredit: Screenshot: FandomWire / Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.

contentBlocks.text:
The easiest starting point is the **Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace** in Crumbling Farum Azula.

From the grace:

1. Turn around so you are facing away from the bridge route.
2. Take the nearby **elevator down one floor**.
3. Walk down the stairs after leaving the elevator.
4. Continue into the **chapel** ahead.
5. Loot the corpse beside the altar to get **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]**.

The Bell Bearing is not dropped by an enemy, so you do not need to defeat anything in the chapel to make the item appear. Crumbling Farum Azula is a late-game area, however, so this unlimited upgrade-material source is naturally locked behind substantial story progression.
contentBlocks.caption: Bell Bearing [5] is found on the corpse at the altar in this chapel below Beside the Great Bridge. Screenshot: The Nerd Stash; Elden Ring © Bandai Namco Entertainment / FromSoftware.
contentBlocks.heading: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 exact location
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The altar room in Crumbling Farum Azula where Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 is found.

contentBlocks.text:
Take the Bell Bearing back to **Roundtable Hold** and give it to the **Twin Maiden Husks**.

It unlocks:

- **Somber Smithing Stone [9]** — 25,000 runes each

The shop supply is unlimited, so this is the reliable late-game solution if you want to take several special armaments from +8 to +9.

If you only need a single stone, Neural Critic's [Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-somber-smithing-stone-9-locations/) also covers earlier pickups in Dragonbarrow and other regions.
contentBlocks.heading: What does Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 unlock?

contentBlocks.text:
Not through a normal early-game route. **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is in Crumbling Farum Azula**, which is reached late in the main progression.

That does not mean you have to wait until Farum Azula to upgrade one special weapon to +9. Individual Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups can be obtained earlier, including two useful sources in **Dragonbarrow**.

The distinction is simple:

- Need **one +9 upgrade** early? Find a loose Somber Smithing Stone [9].
- Need **unlimited +9 materials** for multiple weapons? Get Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5].
contentBlocks.heading: Can you get Bell Bearing 5 early?

contentBlocks.text:
Yes. FromSoftware changed the Twin Maiden Husks' Bell Bearing system so liberated **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing** shop inventory carries into New Game Plus.

Once you have handed Bell Bearing [5] to the Twin Maiden Husks, you do not need to collect it again just to restore the Somber Smithing Stone [9] shop unlock in the next journey.

The Bell Bearing does **not** unlock the final +10 material. Special weapons still require a **Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone** to move from +9 to +10.
contentBlocks.heading: Does Bell Bearing 5 carry into New Game Plus?

quickRead: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is one floor below the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
Give it to the Twin Maiden Husks to buy unlimited Somber Smithing Stone [9] for 25,000 runes each.
The Bell Bearing shop unlock carries into New Game Plus, but it does not unlock the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone required for +10.
conclusion:
For the fastest route, start at **Beside the Great Bridge**, ride the elevator down, descend the stairs and enter the chapel. The corpse beside the altar holds Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5].

Once it is turned in at Roundtable Hold, Somber Smithing Stone [9] stops being a limited pickup problem and becomes an unlimited 25,000-rune purchase.
